snippet.title: SAMSON | Development Diary - City & Car Design
snippet.description:
Samson is out April 8, 2026 for $24,99.  

In this episode, we dive deeply into our gritty city of Tyndalston: the vision behind it, the concepts, and how we actually built it as a team from scratch. We also share more about how the vehicles in the city were built, the challenges and joys in making them, and how visual effects amplified the car combat. 

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634520
Wishlist on Epic Games Store now: https://store.epicgames.com/p/samson-ab5af7

SAMSON is developed and published by Liquid Swords.

👉 Let us know what you think in the comments, and don’t forget to like, subscribe, and follow along for more development diaries.
